headline: Warden Rebound in Weathered Expanse as Linn of Mercy Ignites
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the bitter contest across the central front has yielded sharp tactical shifts. Weathered Expanse witnessed a dramatic reversal of fortunes, with Warden forces reclaiming mastery to hold six strategic bases against a lone Colonial outpost and two neutral ruins, logging six fresh base transitions in the past two hours alone. Along the bloody Nevish Line, Colonial troops solidified their position by securing a second base, eliminating the former vacant pocket to establish a two-to-six partition against Warden defenders. Farther south in Linn of Mercy, intense fighting has exploded with over twenty-seven hundred casualties within two hours; Warden counter-efforts successfully reclaimed a base, shifting the balance to eight Colonial strongholds, two Warden, and one neutral vacancy. Meanwhile, Kuura Strand settled into quiet following its earlier upheaval, remaining frozen at five Colonial bastions and one contested shell. Elsewhere, Marban Hollow endures in a four-to-three stalemate around an unoccupied strongpoint, while Stlican Shelf reports accelerating bloodshed as Colonial lines bear down on the solitary Warden redoubt.
